Iba camino a jujuy en una Dax y el playero al ver que viajaba en esa motito me ofreció tirar carpita en el parque. Decliné porque era temprano aún pero a la vuelta pasé y paré a desayunar. Otro playero y las empleadas del bar me atendieron super. El ACA es lo mejor!!!

(Translated by Google)
I was on my way to Jujuy on a Dax, and the gas station attendant, seeing me on that little motorcycle, offered me a spot to pitch my tent in the park. I declined because it was still early, but on the way back I stopped for breakfast. Another gas station attendant and the bar staff gave me great service. The ACA is the best!!!
